From fa28351f970fa5138c7c5dedfe5dea480a0ee065 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kohei Enju <kohei@enjuk.jp>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 17:53:32 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] ice: fix potential NULL pointer deref in error path of
 ice_set_ringparam()

ice_set_ringparam nullifies tstamp_ring of temporary tx_rings, without
clearing ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME bit.
When ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME is set and the subsequent
ice_setup_tx_ring() call fails, a NULL pointer dereference could happen
in the unwinding sequence:

ice_clean_tx_ring()
-> ice_is_txtime_cfg() == true (ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME is set)
-> ice_free_tx_tstamp_ring()
  -> ice_free_tstamp_ring()
    -> tstamp_ring->desc (NULL deref)

Clear ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME bit to avoid the potential issue.

Note that this potential issue is found by manual code review.
Compile test only since unfortunately I don't have E830 devices.

Fixes: ccde82e90946 ("ice: add E830 Earliest TxTime First Offload support")
Signed-off-by: Kohei Enju <kohei@enjuk.jp>
Reviewed-by: Paul Greenwalt <paul.greenwalt@intel.com>
Tested-by: Rinitha S <sx.rinitha@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Jacob Keller <jacob.e.keller@intel.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260416-iwl-net-submission-2026-04-14-v2-8-686c33c9828d@intel.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ethtool.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ethtool.c
index e6a20af6f63d..f28416a707d7 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ethtool.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ethtool.c
@@ -3290,6 +3290,7 @@ ice_set_ringparam(struct net_device *netdev, struct ethtool_ringparam *ring,
 		tx_rings[i].desc = NULL;
 		tx_rings[i].tx_buf = NULL;
 		tx_rings[i].tstamp_ring = NULL;
+		clear_bit(ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME, tx_rings[i].flags);
 		tx_rings[i].tx_tstamps = &pf->ptp.port.tx;
 		err = ice_setup_tx_ring(&tx_rings[i]);
 		if (err) {
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary

### Modifications

**File:** `drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_ethtool.c`

- After clearing `tstamp_ring` to NULL in the temporary `tx_rings[]`, the patch now also clears the `ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME` flag on the same ring.

### Relationships

The change is contained entirely within the `ice_set_ringparam()` function. The bug arises because when `ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME` remains set after `tstamp_ring` is nullified, a subsequent failure in `ice_setup_tx_ring()` triggers error-handling code (`ice_clean_tx_ring()` → `ice_free_tx_tstamp_ring()` → `ice_free_tstamp_ring()`) that dereferences `tstamp_ring->desc`, causing a NULL pointer dereference. Clearing the flag ensures that the TXTIME-specific cleanup is skipped when no timestamp ring is allocated, preventing the crash.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
tx_rings[i].tstamp_ring = NULL;
Reason:
Setting `tstamp_ring` to NULL without clearing the `ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME` flag leaves the flag set. When `ice_setup_tx_ring()` later fails, the error path calls `ice_clean_tx_ring()` on the temporary ring. In `ice_clean_tx_ring()`, the flag causes `ice_free_tx_tstamp_ring()` to be invoked, which accesses `tstamp_ring->desc` — but `tstamp_ring` is NULL, resulting in a NULL pointer dereference.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
clear_bit(ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME, tx_rings[i].flags);
Reason:
Clearing the `ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME` flag ensures that the error‑path cleanup in `ice_clean_tx_ring()` will not attempt to access the now‑NULL `tstamp_ring` pointer. This prevents the NULL pointer dereference when `ice_setup_tx_ring()` fails and the code unwinds through `ice_free_tx_tstamp_ring()` → `ice_free_tstamp_ring()`.
